correctness.rationale: Quantifier elimination for the generic n-multi-order reduces complete r-types over an m-element parameter set to finite order diagrams. Partitioning the r variables into b equality blocks, pinning t blocks injectively to parameters, and inserting the remaining b-t new labeled blocks into each of n independent parameter orders gives exactly \(\sum_b {r\brace b}\sum_t\binom bt(m)_t((m+1)^{\overline{b-t}})^n\). The degree is nr. The upper dp-rank bound follows from polynomial type growth, while nr independent interval rows give the matching ICT lower bound. The bundled enumerator was independently checked on the displayed low-dimensional cases and agrees with the formula.
